title: Manganese Ore
pages: Manganese Ore and Deepslate Manganese Ore generate in the Overworld between Y -32 and 48 (veins of size 5, up to four veins per chunk column). An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Manganese and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: refractory mixer. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/manganese inputs are accepted.

Smelt or blast Raw Manganese into Manganese Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Manganese into two Manganese Grit in 180 ticks at 5 energy per tick; each grit smelts or blasts into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability, then automate a furnace or blast furnace.

Manganese uses forge:ores/manganese, forge:raw_materials/manganese and forge:ingots/manganese tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Manganese Ingots are stored for later apparatus and material progression. A Lattice Welder welds 3 tagged manganese ingots into 8 wear-resistant manganese-steel rails in 160 ticks at 22 FE/t; feed the top or side ports and extract below.
